title: Chapter 45 Replacement
content:
Chapter 45 Replacement

There are only thousand-year-old families, not thousand-year dynasties.

Can this saying be passed down for thousands of years? It is not unreasonable, except for the Shang and Zhou Dynasties at the beginning, which dynasty has really reached its lifespan of thousands of years!

Even the Shang and Zhou dynasties were only 500 and 800 years old, but they were much better than the Han Dynasty, which was divided into two periods, which were called Eastern Han and Western Han by later generations.

Since the Eastern Han Dynasty, those aristocratic families began to connect in the countryside, controlled a large amount of land and population, and kept raising soldiers.

And because he controlled a large amount of resources and monopolized knowledge, various talents continued to emerge, served as military officers and civil officials in the Han Dynasty, and mastered all the power. Even the imperial power was suppressed and became the masters of those aristocratic families puppet.

This was the case for countless dynasties after that, except for the Qin Dynasty and the Western Han Dynasty, there were some exceptions.

However, these two dynasties could only be achieved on the basis of continuous suppression and restriction of the generation of aristocratic families.

Their policy is like this, all property, population, land, and families that reach a certain level must be moved to Guanzhong, which is the residence of the emperor, and become a rich man.

And when they left the place, they also lost all their relationship networks and their identity as local snakes. He has become an ordinary rich man who only has money, but has no power to protect those wealth.

Anyone, as long as they have power and power, can bully them at will, so that they will not pose a threat to the dynasty.

This policy continued until they were about to perish, and when the Eastern Han Dynasty was established, it was because of Emperor Guangwu Liu Xiu, who was a puppet supported by those aristocratic families.

Therefore, he had to support those great families with all his strength to maintain his own rule, but it caused disasters for thousands of years, so that the future dynasties had to do the same.

So, if I don't want my subsequent conquest and rule to be controlled by those moths in the country, then I must have my own talent reserve so that I can kick them away and do it alone.

So how many talents can be exchanged for 1000 luck points? A junior scribe needs ten luck points, and if he has 1000 luck points, he can only be exchanged for 100 people.

As I said before, imperial power does not go to the countryside. So if I want to truly control this territory, I must let my tentacles go deep into the entire village.

The administration at the pavilion level does not have to think about it on its own, and it is enough to arrange for veterans who are loyal to themselves but have to quit the army due to injuries to serve as the pavilion chiefs.

The administration at the township level needs three people, and the county seat needs six people. According to the system of the Han Dynasty, there were three townships in small counties and five townships in large counties.

Then for each county, I need to prepare 15 to 21 junior scribes, as well as a county magistrate and county lieutenant. The conditions are very difficult!

In this way, with 100 luck points, I can only prepare the talent pool of five counties. Then it can only make up for this gap by constantly plundering luck points in the Three Kingdoms world.

I just read the introduction of the system myself. According to the different world levels, each of them has different luck points.

According to the level of power, the world without extraordinary power belongs to the first level; the world with extraordinary power, but generally only the second and third level belongs to the second level; the world with the fourth and fifth level power belongs to the third level; Creatures, but the highest power is only the world of demigods belongs to the fourth level; and then the world I am now, with the existence of gods, belongs to the fifth level world.

In my own world, 50 people can generate a little luck. For the fourth-level world, 100 people are required, for the third-level world, 150 people, for the second-level world, 200 people, and for the first-level world, 250 people. and so on.

During the Three Kingdoms period, a county had a population of tens of thousands. Based on his 25,000 people, he can generate one hundred luck points every month, which can be exchanged for ten junior scribes.

If you can't wait and want to get more Luck points in a short time, then kill those people, you can get ten times his monthly Luck points.

This is not a long-term solution, but if he wants to overthrow all the aristocratic families, then he must kill a lot of people, and he just uses the luck points obtained from those killings to exchange for talents and troops.

This is like a snowball, the more people you kill and the more battles you fight, the stronger your own strength will become.

So let's do this first, and use all my 1,000 luck points to exchange for the army. With his 2,000 troops, plus the luck value generated this month, he can use his troops to conquer those worlds with him.

Then I can occupy his territory in one or two counties in a short period of time. Therefore, the efficiency of those officials and the army in the feudal era may not know a county they occupied within a few months.

If you want to beat yourself, you need to notify the upper management, dispatch troops and generals, level by level. In this way, it cannot be completed without him for half a year.

I can also take this opportunity to use the luck points generated by those counties to recruit soldiers and scribes, consolidate my own achievements and rule, and overthrow those aristocratic families in the ruling territory.

The accumulation, the background, came out at this time, if you slow down a step, you can get out of hand and form a monstrous wave, sweeping everything.

Now, I have to arrange the internal affairs of the territory first. I just asked the system, and the time ratio of those worlds to my own world is about 100:1.

If he wanted to unify the entire Three Kingdoms, it would take him at least ten years. After all, I still have to clean up those aristocratic families, and it's not just a matter of reunification.

If I do the calculations like this, it will take me a month to come back in my early days. I have to arrange it well for such a long time.

If you want to bring your current troops there, you need to pay an additional 10% of the original value of those troops' luck points. If 1000 luck points are exchanged for 2,000 troops, 100 luck points are needed to pay extra.

And now there are 13,500 people in his territory, and he can get 275 luck points this month. After spending 100 luck points, he still has 175 points left.

An intermediate scribe is also a third-level power, and his exchange price is five times that of a junior scribe's second-level power. He needs 50 luck points, and the price of generals is the same.

In this territory of my own, I still need a county magistrate and a county lieutenant, who just use 100 luck points to recruit them back, in case the territory is chaotic after I leave for a month, they can also take charge of the overall situation of the territory.

With the remaining 75 points of luck, there are still a few civil servants in his own territory, so he can use 25 points of luck first to recruit five junior scribes for backup.

For the remaining 50 points of luck, let’s summon ten generals. In a county town, except for the county lieutenant, three military positions are needed, patrolling the arresting house, guarding the guard, and guarding the guard.

No one has been filled in these three military counties, so the remaining seven should be signed into the army. It just so happens that those who were born in Yehu Chan don't like it.

Get rid of everything, let those who have received formal training be in charge, and take care of the troops with impetuous morale

During this expedition, I found that there are too many problems with these troops. If I don't train them well, how can I be assured that I can let them take care of my territory!

I'm in a bad mood today, and the third watch will make everyone feel better.
